info.name: E-Commerce - Shipping Service
info.description: Run with the Collection Runner (the 'Wait for ...' requests retry while Kafka events travel). Needs discovery-server, config-server and all services. A paid order becomes a shipment; the warehouse packs and ships it, the carrier's scans move it to the customer's door (with one missed delivery), and order-service follows every step. A second order is cancelled before shipping.

item.name: Wait for the phone's inventory item (Kafka)

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.code === 200; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('inventory-service created the item', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

item.name: Wait for the shipment (ORDER_CONFIRMED via Kafka)

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.code === 200; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('shipping-service created the shipment', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
pm.test('Delivery estimate and address', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.estimatedDeliveryDate).to.exist; pm.expect(d.deliveryAddress.postalCode).to.eql('560001'); });

item.name: Wait for the order to be SHIPPED (SHIPMENT_SHIPPED via Kafka)

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.status === 'SHIPPED'; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('order is SHIPPED', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

pm.test('Carrier, tracking number and delivery date on the order', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.carrier).to.eql('Delhivery'); pm.expect(d.trackingNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('trackingNumber')); pm.expect(d.estimatedDeliveryDate).to.exist; });

item.name: Public tracking page (no token, no personal details)

exec: pm.test('No name, phone, street or order number', () => { const body = pm.response.text(); ['Omesh', '9876543210', 'Green Residency', pm.collectionVariables.get('orderNumber')].forEach(s => pm.expect(body).to.not.include(s)); });

item.name: Wait: the order's timeline shows the missed delivery (Kafka)

exec: // missed delivery on the order timeline
// Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.timeline.some(t => (t.note || '').startsWith('Delivery attempt failed')); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('missed delivery on the order timeline', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
